name: Zinger Burger
description: Crispy spicy chicken fillet burger with a seasoned crunchy coating, lettuce and creamy mayonnaise.
ingredients: ½ cup milk or water for egg wash
1 tsp salt, divided or to taste
method: Pat the chicken dry and season it with some of the salt, chili powder, paprika and black pepper. Refrigerate for 20–30 minutes while preparing the coating.
Mix flour, cornflour and the remaining seasoning in a shallow bowl. In another bowl beat the egg with the milk or water.
Dip each fillet in the egg mixture, then press firmly into the seasoned flour mixture so an even craggy coating forms.
Heat frying oil over medium heat. Fry the chicken without overcrowding the pan, turning as needed, until the coating is deep golden and the centre is fully cooked; chicken should reach 74°C/165°F.
Drain the fried fillets on a rack or kitchen paper. Toast the cut sides of the burger buns lightly.
Spread mayonnaise on the buns, add lettuce and the hot crispy chicken fillet, close the burger and serve immediately.
tips: Flatten fillets to an even thickness so the centre cooks before the coating becomes too dark.
If the coating browns very quickly, lower the oil temperature rather than serving chicken that may still be raw inside.
storage: Cooked chicken is best served immediately. Refrigerate leftovers promptly for up to 2 days and reheat thoroughly before assembling a fresh burger.
